headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawBalancedTest_eq
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ) (state : Math115.ReducedSmallChain.States r c U L),
  OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.balancedTest
        (Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.computedStateCode r c U L state, U) =
      true ↔
    Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.IsBalanced r c U L state

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawDyadicNeighborDraw_eq
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ),
  ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j →
    ∀ (state : Math115.ReducedSmallChain.States r c U L)
      (word : Fin (Nat.clog 2 (32 * OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance ^ 2)) → Bool),
      Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawDyadicNeighborDraw (List.ofFn r) (List.ofFn c) U
          OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance
          (Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.computedStateCode r c U L state) (List.ofFn word) =
        Option.map (Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.computedStateCode r c U L)
          (Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.computedProposal r c U L state word)

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawStarStep_eq
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length),
  ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j →
    ∀ (b : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.BalancedVertices r c U L) (h : ℕ)
      (word :
        Fin
            (Nat.clog 2 (32 * OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance ^ 2) +
              Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.bits r c U L hr hc (↑b) h) →
          Bool),
      Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawStarStep (List.ofFn r) (List.ofFn c) U L
          OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance h
          (Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.computedStateCode r c U L ↑b) (List.ofFn word) =
        Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.computedStateCode r c U L
          (Math115.PhysicalStarTrial.actualStep r c U L hr hc b h word)

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawStarExit_eq
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length),
  ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j →
    ∀ (b : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.BalancedVertices r c U L) (h : ℕ)
      (entering : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L) (J : ℕ)
      (word :
        Fin
            (J *
              (Nat.clog 2 (32 * OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance ^ 2) +
                Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.bits r c U L hr hc (↑b) h)) →
          Bool),
      Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawStarExit (List.ofFn r) (List.ofFn c) U L
          OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance h
          (Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.computedStateCode r c U L ↑b)
          (Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.computedStateCode r c U L ↑entering) J (List.ofFn word) =
        Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.computedStateCode r c U L
          ↑(Math115.PhysicalStarRetry.flatExit r c U L hr hc b h entering J word)

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawStarExit_eq_reserved
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length),
  ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j →
    ∀ (b : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.BalancedVertices r c U L) (h : ℕ)
      (entering : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L) (J N : ℕ)
      (hN :
        J *
            (Nat.clog 2 (32 * OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance ^ 2) +
              Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.bits r c U L hr hc (↑b) h) ≤
          N)
      (word : Fin N → Bool),
      Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawStarExit (List.ofFn r) (List.ofFn c) U L
          OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance h
          (Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.computedStateCode r c U L ↑b)
          (Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.computedStateCode r c U L ↑entering) J (List.ofFn word) =
        Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.computedStateCode r c U L
          ↑(Math115.PhysicalStarRetry.flatExit r c U L hr hc b h entering J
              (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.prefixWord hN word))
